hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if echo "$f" | grep -q 'pnpm-lock\.yaml'; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Do not edit pnpm-lock.yaml directly — use pnpm commands"}'; exit 2; fi
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] && echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(ts|astro|js|mjs)$' && pnpm eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null; exit 0
